name: China

nationalGame.name: Table Tennis
nationalGame.about: Called ping pong here — China's national sport and its most successful one by far.

loved.name: Table Tennis
loved.why: Parks and schools everywhere have tables — and China keeps winning the Olympic golds.

loved.name: Basketball
loved.why: Millions follow the games, and arenas fill up fast.

fact: In 1971 a friendly ping-pong match helped China and the USA restart talks after 20 frozen years — it was called 'ping-pong diplomacy'.
